verdict.rationale: PayPal's REST docs say developers can explore REST API descriptions, generate client code, and import OpenAPI documents into third-party tools. The official paypal-rest-api-specifications repo ships OpenAPI JSON files (e.g. openapi/checkout_orders_v2.json) with codegen commands, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration that the spec files are complete and current, and documented coverage of which APIs (beyond Orders v2) have published specs.
